# Architecture Overview

## System Components
- FastAPI application server
- PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector extension
- BGE-M3 embedding model (local)
- APScheduler for background tasks

## Data Flow
1. Source adapters fetch data from Slack / Backlog / Redmine
2. Normalizers convert to domain objects
3. Embedding service generates dense vectors
4. Repository layer persists to PostgreSQL
5. Query endpoint performs hybrid search (FTS + vector + RRF)
